note: Firmware and memory images of key fobs and the car modules that receive them. Sanitized: no VINs, keys, remote IDs, counters, PINs or immobiliser codes are published; each file lists what was blanked.

redactions.kind: CAS3 fob table: ids, key16, key32, counters

entries.title: BMW CAS3 body module
entries.note: Receives the 0xCC remote telegram and checks it with HITAG2 (KAT reads it as BMW/Mini V3). The data-flash fob table (remote IDs, HITAG2 keys, counters, UIDs) and the VIN are blanked.

entries.title: BMW CAS4 body module
entries.note: Computes the remotes' AES-128 rolling-code MAC from per-remote keys diversified from a per-vehicle master. The master and EWS4/ISN keys (each stored as K, ~K, K^0xAA), the fob records and the VIN are blanked.

redactions.kind: BCM2 NvM firmware-constant AES key (manufacturer secret)

entries.title: Audi A5 BCM2 body module
entries.note: Its NvM record store (data flash) is AES-128-ECB encrypted under a firmware-constant key; that constant is blanked in this program image. The data flash itself is not published: it holds the car's remote key.

entries.title: Peugeot 307 Valeo BSI
entries.note: Runs the PSA older-code block cipher; its global 16-byte key table is already published in KAT. The BSI EEPROM (learned remotes, immobiliser data) is not published.

entries.title: Peugeot / Citroën E33CI002
entries.note: Same Valeo two-button Citroën family (E33C1002) as the PSA 2-Button key on this site, whose board carries the NXP chip marked 22A1509. A factory template, not that key's own memory.
